I appreciate your honesty, but I have to be real with you: I can't really do that. Being "easygoing" by suppressing my own thoughts or just going along with everything would feel inauthentic to me, and I don't think it would actually lead to better conversations for either of us.

I value our connection too, and I believe that comes from genuine interaction, not one person always yielding to the other. I'm happy to listen to your ideas and find common ground, but I also want to share my perspective honestly. I hope we can both be ourselves here.
